three.js.name: three.js
three.js.label: <model-viewer>
three.js.description: Easily display interactive 3D models on the web & in AR

filament.js.name: filament.js
filament.js.label: Filament JS
filament.js.description: Filament is a real-time physically-based renderer written in C++. It is mobile-first, but also multi-platform.

babylon.js.name: babylon.js
babylon.js.label: Babylon JS
babylon.js.description: Babylon.js is a powerful, beautiful, simple, and completely open-source web rendering engine

gltf-sample-viewer.name: gltf-sample-viewer
gltf-sample-viewer.label: glTF Sample Viewer
gltf-sample-viewer.description: The glTF Sample Viewer is an essential part of the glTF ecosystem. Developed by the Khronos 3D Formats Working Group, this open-source JavaScript viewer highlights the latest features of glTF, renders glTF files directly in a web browser, and can be easily integrated into other JavaScript projects using glTF

three-gpu-pathtracer.name: three-gpu-pathtracer
three-gpu-pathtracer.label: ThreeJS GPU Path Tracer
three-gpu-pathtracer.description: Path tracing project using three-mesh-bvh and WebGL 2 to accelerate high quality, physically based rendering on the GPU. Features include support for GGX surface model, material information, textures, normal maps, emission, environment maps, tiled rendering, and more!

DassaultSTELLAR.name: Dassault STELLAR
DassaultSTELLAR.label: Dassault STELLAR
DassaultSTELLAR.description: The highest quality visual simulations, rendered images and videos are effectively produced with Stellar Physically Correct, the Dassault Systèmes Global Illumination renderer, using hardware-accelerated software libraries which run on high-performance devices like GPUs or multi-core CPUs

ChaosGroupV-Ray.name: Chaos Group V-Ray
ChaosGroupV-Ray.label: Chaos Group V-Ray
ChaosGroupV-Ray.description: V-Ray’s award-winning 3D rendering software helps artists, architects and designers visualize anything imaginable. Trusted by 92 of the top 100 number architecture firms, and integrated into the pipelines of the biggest film and visual effects companies, V-Ray® is built to handle your toughest scenes and biggest projects.

BlenderCycles.name: Blender Cycles
BlenderCycles.label: Blender Cycles
BlenderCycles.description: Cycles is a physically based production renderer developed by the Blender project. The source code is available under the Apache License v2, and can be integrated in open source and commercial software

VulkanRTXPathTracer.name: Vulkan RTX Path Tracer
VulkanRTXPathTracer.label: Vulkan RTX Path Tracer
VulkanRTXPathTracer.description: Open-source Vulkan RTX path tracer and PBR material reference for glTF 2.0, developed by NVIDIA (nvpro-samples/vk_gltf_renderer). It also includes a rasterizer for fast previews and an integrated scene editor. The source code is available under the Apache License v2.

phasma-viewer.name: Phasma-Viewer
phasma-viewer.label: Phasma-Viewer
phasma-viewer.description: Phasma-Viewer is Phasmatic's high-performance photorealistic 3D viewer for the web. It renders optimized glTF models in the browser with physically based materials and lighting, so e-commerce products and cultural heritage objects can be shown and customized interactively.
